self_review.kind: self review; no external model or subagent

findings.conclusion: Read-only OpenProcess/GetProcessTimes/wait. API failure alone is not death; PID enumeration must be complete before absence is used. Creation mismatch checks old binding, not sender authentication. Final observed proofs are all same_process_signaled; PID absence/reuse and actual permission errors are not natively proven.

BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes close with accept. Terminal record, operation id, durable cutoff and clearing active epoch commit together; before/after crash and real SQLITE_FULL retain correct rollback/commit state.
Target may die after live check inside an already-open accept transaction. Race test commits afterward, then includes those rows in terminal cutoff. No atomic cross-OS/SQLite death guarantee.

No trusted final producer watermark, so every final terminal remains tail_unknown=true. Observed-but-uncommitted interval is discarded by this closed protocol, not proof that every external copy is physically lost.

Active replay after lost commit receipt deduplicates and can issue a post-commit ACK. Ended replay is a read-only exact payload check with ack null. New rows and old epoch accept rejected; negative control actually inserted eight late rows per run and remains failed.

One pass derives epoch/identity from existing database; live and unknown defer. Self-review found missing path created an empty database and returned no_active_session. Real failing check archived, fixed using require_existing plus SQLite URI mode=rw; success check and full 54-case matrix repeated.

Native EXE unchanged and provenance verified. Recovery does not keep target alive or perform its teardown. This is separate protocol/stimulus testing, not yet integration into the frozen autonomous relay or product.
